testSteps.description: Given the batch's remaining lifetime has fallen below the reissue trigger lifetime left threshold provided by the issuer
When the wallet checks the batch's remaining lifetime
Then the wallet silently reissues a fresh batch of N instances without notifying me

userStory.storyName: Randomized balanced rotation with silent renewal under Method C (rotating-batch)
userStory.displayName: Randomized balanced rotation with silent renewal under Method C (rotating-batch)
userStory.narrative: As a Wallet User, I want the wallet to rotate through all technical attestations in a batch in a random and balanced way, and automatically reset the rotation cycle once every attestation has been used at least once, so that my presentations remain unlinkable and the batch continues functioning seamlessly until it expires.
